stories.summary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is escalating rapidly, with the United Nations reporting that the death toll has surpassed 2,500. The scale and geographic spread have intensified pressure on surveillance, care and infection-control operations, while the role of available vaccines remains constrained by the virus involved.
